## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Name the owning module and affected contract.

## Validation

List checks actually run and material limitations. Distinguish fixtures, live
systems, targets, and measured results.

## Review

- [ ] Dependency boundaries and optional-feature removal remain sound.
- [ ] Applicable failure, cancellation, authority, and recovery cases are covered.
- [ ] Code and comments follow docs/CODING_STYLE.md.
- [ ] New commits and changed material contain no coding-agent attribution.
- [ ] Third-party license notices are preserved.
- [ ] Semantic unknowns and conflicts are explicit; evidence records tested conditions and limits.
- [ ] Local planning, private data, and credentials are absent from the diff.
